verdict.rationale: Raygun ships an AI Error Resolution chat where users converse in natural language about an error, using LLM prompts auto-filled with stack-trace context. It also has an official first-party MCP server, which lets AI agents talk to Raygun in natural language. However, the chat is documented only for diagnosing and fixing errors, not for operating the product (triage, status changes, configuration), and the MCP server's tool coverage is undocumented in the pack. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of core product actions (resolve/ignore errors, filters, settings), detail on which operations the MCP server exposes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
